historical: function createReviews(storage,key='afaq-speech-reviews-v1'){let raw=storage.getItem(key),value=raw===null?{version:1,entries:{},preferences:{questionReading:false,pronunciationExamples:false,rate:.85,music:false}}:JSON.parse(raw);const valid=v=>v?.version===1&&v.entries&&typeof v.entries==='object'&&!Array.isArray(v.entries)&&v.preferences&&typeof v.preferences.questionReading==='boolean'&&typeof v.preferences.pronunciationExamples==='boolean'&&Number.isFinite(v.preferences.rate)&&v.preferences.rate>=.65&&v.preferences.rate<=1.1&&typeof v.preferences.music==='boolean';if(!valid(value))throw Error('Unreadable speech reviews');function save(next){if(storage.getItem(key)!==raw)throw Error('Speech preferences changed elsewhere');if(!valid(next))throw Error('Invalid speech preferences');const bytes=JSON.stringify(next);storage.setItem(key,bytes);raw=bytes;value=next;return structuredClone(value);}return {read:()=>structuredClone(value),preferences:patch=>save({...value,preferences:{...value.preferences,...patch}}),review(entry,voice,rate,status,reviewer){if(!['approved','rejected'].includes(status)||!reviewer.trim()||!localArabic([voice]).length)throw Error('Invalid speech review');return save({...value,entries:{...value.entries,[entry.id]:{...entry,status,reviewer:reviewer.trim(),reviewedAt:new Date().toISOString(),signature:signature(entry,voice,rate)}}});},approved(entry,voice,rate){const r=value.entries[entry.id];return r?.version===1&&r.status==='approved'&&r.signature===signature(entry,voice,rate)&&!!r.reviewer?.trim()&&Number.isFinite(Date.parse(r.reviewedAt));}};}
